title: The Paint on the Doorframe
youtube_title: The Paint on the Doorframe | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Sable is tangled up with a thumb of blue paint on the doorframe and almost hides it. Sable tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
